verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a managed streaming service rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server for IVS. The AWS llms.txt file, the CLI and the EventBridge integration are adjacent machine-readable or automation surfaces, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
